args.title: Corvid Packaging: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026," from newsletter@corvid.example): Announces this week's feature on cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to the full article at blog.corvid.example and offering free, no-password registration (email only) for the companion piece at insights.corvid.example.

• Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.

• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/cold-chain/companion, accessed with email registration): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
